record.question: The recently damaged roads are being repaired by them. Select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Active Voice:
options: They repaired the recently damaged roads.
They have repaired the recently damaged roads.
They are repairing the recently damaged roads.
The recently damaged roads were repaired by them.
record.explanation: The passive are being repaired is present continuous. Making the agent they the subject gives They are repairing the recently damaged roads, preserving tense, aspect, and meaning. Reviewed solution (unofficial). References: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/active-passive-voice
